hosting.//: dist/audit-site, not packages/web/public. That directory's index.html is the operator console — an internal telemetry dashboard — and publishing it would put the console at the root of a public site with the thing that actually sells buried at /audit. dist/audit-site is exactly the audit page and its two modules, nothing else.
